claim: On gfx1100, exact cooperative planar-Q6 siblings replace the one-wave Q6 FFN-down prefill parent for (K,N)=(17408,5120): row64 at rows 33-128 and shared256 at rows 129-511. A two-pair counterbalanced full-category C1-C3 server gate improves mean C1 AR prompt throughput 157.659 to 168.217 tok/s (+6.70%), with 240/240 paired generated rows equal, both 120/120 repeat sets equal, stable full C2/C3 groups, and zero final allocations.

model.execution_weight_tier: q6_k_t16_qmicro_planar_v1 for the qualified FFN-down tensors

change.mechanism: The row64 and shared256 leaves preserve the one-wave parent's per-output K16 WMMA, FP32 accumulation, and BF16 store order. They change only row ownership and cooperative weight sharing to avoid low-wave supply and padded row work.
change.misses: Rows <=32, rows >=512, unqualified shapes, non-WMMA physical verification, decode, and peer backends retain their prior owners.
change.fallback: t16_wmma_prefill_single_wave_bf16_bf16_out remains separately registered. HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q6_PLANAR_EXACT_PREFILL=0 restores it on the same build.

commands.counterbalanced_server_gate: COMMON=(--model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --widths 1,2,3 --resident-capacity 8 --expected-mtp-widths none --max-tokens 1 --candidate-budget 3 --mtp-request-mode automatic --execution-profile production --batch-window-ms 20 --max-sequence-length 1024 --capture-prefill-attribution); HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q6_PLANAR_EXACT_PREFILL=<0-or-1> timeout 420 .venv/bin/python scripts/gguf_mtp_c1c8_server_bench.py "${COMMON[@]}" --output <packet>; process order r1=rollback,candidate and r2=candidate,rollback
commands.retained_symbol_trace: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_EXECUTION_PROFILE=production HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q6_PLANAR_EXACT_PREFILL=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/he-prefill-p13/hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 timeout 300 rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/he-prefill-p13/c1-candidate-final-trace -o candidate-final -- .venv/bin/python /tmp/he-prefill-p13/c1_candidate_trace_driver.py

parent_amdahl_profile.protocol: Direct public LLM.generate child; all ten category+heldout prompts; two warmups then ten one-token C1 operations; production profile; cached rocprof kernel trace; one-wave rollback.

actual_weight_leaf_gate.timing: 25 launches/pass, five forward/reverse order pairs, median of pass medians, actual model weight and deterministic BF16 activations
actual_weight_leaf_gate.correctness: Every captured candidate output is finite and BF16-bit exact to the separately registered one-wave parent.
actual_weight_leaf_gate.boundary: Row64 wins both order directions through row128; shared256 wins both directions from row129 through the tested row511. Row512 remains outside this exact policy because the independently qualified source-F16 route owns that regime.

server_gate.protocol: Canonical mtp-bench code/general_en/general_ja/mixed_ja_en suite, ten prompts including four heldouts, C1-C3, AR plus automatic omitted-request exact K0 comparator, one output token, production profile, complete blocking barrier-to-last-response wall, actual native-group capture.
server_gate.native_groups: Both arms and both repeats form full size-2 groups in 10/10 C2 cells and full size-3 groups in 10/10 C3 cells.
server_gate.memory: All four packets finish at zero current bytes and zero active allocations; each peaks at 22,526,457,124 tracked bytes.

gates.strict_parent_parity: Rows 17/35/64/65 are byte-exact to the one-wave parent; the complete Q6 kernel file passes 60/60 on W7900.
gates.selector_and_fallback: Focused package band, rollback, registration, and parent-fallback contracts pass 2/2 after the measured row128 boundary update.
gates.outer_gate: Both counterbalanced full-suite pairs pass all harness correctness, route, grouping, and memory gates.
gates.trace: The expected row64 symbol executes 32 times per public operation with plausible resources and durations.

limitations: This exact route removes one diagnosed planar-Q6 sub-window; fused Q4 gate/up remains the largest traced family and is a separate optimization unit.
C1 remains behind the strongest same-host peer by 16.29%, so overall cross-engine prefill parity remains open.
Generated-ID equality is diagnostic under the production profile; this candidate is arithmetic-exact to its registered strict parent, so no production-numerics threshold is consumed.
The comparison environment seam remains through one release checkpoint per docs/REFACTOR.md; the separately registered parent remains permanently as numerical and peer-backend fallback.
